title: Kuzviisa Pasi KwaChangamire
intro: Unozviwana uri munyika ine zvishamiso zvekare uye zvakazarurwa zvakadzama. Mutongi ane simba, akatarisana nekukokwa kusingatarisirwi, akatanga rwendo rwaizochinja mafambiro eramangwana rake nekutenda kwevanhu vake. Unogona here kuburitsa pachena kuti ndiani uyu munhu mukuru?
clues: Ndakatonga umambo hwakabudirira, hwakashongedzwa nepfuma yakawanda uye chigaro cheumambo chinoyevedza.
Ini nevanhu vangu tainamata muviri wekudenga, tichiutenda kuti ndiShe wedu, kunyange zvazvo ndaive nekusava nechokwadi mumoyo mangu.
Nhume inoshamisa, shiri, yakanditumira tsamba, ichinditi ini nevanhu vangu tizviise pasi paMwari Mumwe Chete.
Ndakabvunza vapi vemazano vangu, avo vaiva nesimba guru, kuti ndingapindura sei shoko iri risati ramboitika.
Ndakasarudza kutumira chipo chinokosha kune akatumira tsamba, ndichitarisira kuona simba rake nezvinangwa zvake.
Pandakasvika, ndakashamiswa neimba yamambo ine pasi rakagadzirwa negirazi, richitaridzika sedziva remvura, uye ndipo pandakazivisa kuzviisa pasi paIshe wezvisikwa zvose.
arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
